name: Cottage Cheese Apricot Bites with Almonds, Sesame, Honey & Cinnamon
instructions: Wash, dry, and halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Arrange on a baking sheet pan or platter, cut-side facing up.
Top each apricot half with 1 tablespoon of cottage cheese.
Roughly chop almonds. Sprinkle almonds and sesame seeds over the apricots.
To serve, divide apricots between plates. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
